subject: Recap: Dedicated capacity discussion - ZenHealth next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Dedicated capacity discussion - ZenHealth next steps

Hi Alex -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the proposed next steps so we all have the same context.

Summary of pain points you shared:
- Unpredictable inference latency during peak hours on current multi-tenant endpoints, causing degraded UX for clinicians.
- Need strict data isolation and control (HIPAA impact) - no shared-tenancy for PHI workflows.
- Current capacity planning is manual and slow; you need predictable throughput for new triage features (low tail latency at scale).

Goals & constraints:
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) with private networking/VPC peering.
- Target SLA: 99.9% availability, 95th percentile latency target ~100ms for short-form inference paths.
- Throughput target: baseline to support ~300 concurrent requests (approx 90 req/s), allow bursting up to 600 concurrent with autoscaling/burst capacity.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + HIPAA controls, audit logs, and customer-managed KMS.

Recommended setup (high-level):
- Initial deployment: 4x A100-class GPUs (reserved) in a VPC private deployment.
- Autoscale policy: burst to 8 GPUs for predictable traffic spikes; warm standby to reduce cold-start tails.
- Isolation: dedicated tenancy for ZenHealth with VPC peering and optional on-prem connector for air-gapped ingestion.
- Controls: audit logs + per-route token routing; can pin model family and quantization profile per workload to guarantee latency/cost.

Open items / next steps:
1) I attached a draft SOW and a short network requirements spreadsheet for your infra team to review (zenhealth_capacity_sow_draft.pdf, zenhealth_network_requirements.xlsx).
2) Technical deep-dive (solutions + infra): propose Tue Mar 23, 11:00 AM PT - Dev Patel will run through network, routing, and autoscale behavior.
3) I'll follow up with a ballpark pricing estimate and a proposed kickoff timeline after Dev's deep-dive.
4) Please confirm HIPAA scope and any additional controls required beyond SOC 2 so we can include in the SOW.

Thanks - happy to iterate on the plan.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa -

Thanks for the thorough recap. That matches our internal notes. A few clarifications from my side:

- HIPAA is required end-to-end for the workflows that touch PHI. We do expect a BAA and SOC 2 Type II.
- Latency target: 95th percentile ~100ms for the short inference endpoint is a hard target for the triage UI; 99th percentile can be relaxed, but we care about consistency.
- Network: we prefer VPC peering over public egress. We can share our firewall rules - I forwarded this thread to our infra alias (ZenHealth IT).
- Pricing: we'll need a high-level monthly estimate for 4 GPUs reserved + burst pricing. Also note that procurement will ask for standard 60-day payment terms.

Next steps for us:
- I'll review the SOW and network spreadsheet with infra and get back with a few questions by early next week.
- Marissa - Tue Mar 23, 11:00 AM PT works for us for the technical deep-dive. Dev, can you include an infra/network checklist for peering?

Thanks - looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
